verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS platform that holds customer entity, license, and tax data and ships an AI feature (Compliance Navigator AI), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-use policy for AI, or any related privacy control. The pack covers only API auth, rate limits, and product features, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
